## Purpose
`/admin/admins`: lists the platform administrators, and lets an admin invite another, edit or remove one, and issue a sign-in link.

## Responsibilities
- **`AdminsPage`:**
  - `adminApi.admins` for the list;
  - updateAdmin, deleteAdmin (toast "Admin removed") and adminLink, from a dropdown;
  - `InviteAdminDialog`: `createAdmin`, toast "<name> added", and the link is shown to copy.
- Titled "Admins — Admin console".

## Key elements
`AdminsPage`, `InviteAdminDialog`.

## Control flow
React Query.

## Data, state and side effects
Admin accounts.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/admin/admins`.
- **Uses:** `components/admin/parts` and `AuthParts`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- The server protects the last admin and yourself.

## Nuances and gotchas
Invites produce a link to send manually; no email is sent.

## How to rebuild this file
A list plus a dialog.

None.
